title: I built a full turn-based crime & trading game using AI for art, music, and code. Now in closed beta on Android
author: Sad_Whereas_6161
selftext:
Hey! I'm René, a solo dev. Lushgrave is a turn-based crime and trading game I built in Unity over about 2 years.



Gameplay: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WZ8WzBynuNs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WZ8WzBynuNs)



How AI fit in:

\- Art & music: AI-generated

\- Code: a lot of it written with AI coding assistants (Claude, ChatGPT), then tested and tuned by me

\- Animations: made with my own tool that turns AI videos into transparent PNG frames for Unity



What I did myself: game design, systems, balancing, and testing (I audited all 38 combat skills and fixed 13 bugs), plus fixing a crash on 4 GB phones by rebuilding the effects pipeline.



It's in closed beta on Android. Want to try it? DM me your Google Play email or send it to beta at chronalynx dot com.



Happy to answer questions about the workflow!
